description: React component UsersPage that manages user data: fetches users from API, provides search functionality, and supports create/edit modals.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of users from the '/db/users' endpoint and updates component state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user input for name and email fields during create/edit.

methods.name: onOpenCreate
methods.description: Prepares state for creating a new user and shows the create/edit modal.

methods.name: onOpenEdit
methods.description: Prepares state to edit an existing user and shows the create/edit modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves user data via API call (create or update) and updates the user list.
